en: Colorized historic postcard labeled 'Karisbad. Westend.' showing an elegant urban streetscape with tree-lined green space in the foreground and ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings in the background. On the left is a grand mansion identified as Villa Ritter, next to another large building marked Evangel. Hospiz. On the right stands a prominent Russian Orthodox church with onion domes of blue and gold topped with crosses, labeled Russische Kirche. The lower margin includes the publisher imprint and a note that it is a hand-colored artist card.
